Identified as this saint because: Commons names the Menologion of Basil II miniature for Erastus of Corinth, Olympas, Rhodion, Sosipater, Quartus and Tertius — apostles of the Seventy, the rank this folder gives. The Sosipater of that company is the bishop of Iconium, kept on 29 April with Jason and again with these on 10 November. He is shown among the six, not alone.
